prompts.prompt: Mara put the only key in a blue cup. Later, her brother moved the cup onto a high shelf. When Mara needed to open the garden gate, she looked at the empty table.
A small cart lost one wheel on the way to the market. Jo had a piece of string and a round wooden lid. The apples had to arrive before noon.
Nell and Bo spread their picnic blanket under a tree. Rain began to fall, but the little dog refused to leave the basket. A dry shed stood across the field.
Two friends wanted to paint different pictures, but there was only one pot of yellow paint. One needed a sun and the other needed a duck. They stopped to make a plan.
Every morning a bell told the village that the bridge was open. Today the bell was silent. A mouse who lived beside the rope heard someone calling from the other bank.
I promised my sister I would keep her paper boat dry. Then a gust of wind carried it toward a puddle. I was holding a heavy bag with both hands.
The rabbit planted three seeds beside a stone. By morning, two green shoots had appeared. The rabbit wanted to dig up the third seed, but the mole asked him to wait.
A parcel meant for the baker arrived at the shoemaker’s door. Inside was a soft white bag and a note asking for help before the party. The shoemaker read the address again.
The fox knew a short path through the mud and a long path over dry stones. His friend carried a cake that could not get wet. Dark clouds were moving toward them.
“You can join our game,” said Ada, “but we need a rule everyone can follow.” The youngest child could not jump as far as the others. Ada drew a new line in the sand.
The lamp went out while Grandfather was telling a story. Sam knew there was a candle in the drawer, but the drawer was stuck. Outside, the moon shone through the kitchen window.
A bird practiced a song for her shy friend. When the friend arrived, she forgot the last few notes. The friend tapped a slow rhythm on the branch and waited.
